Dol-P and Dol-PP pools (cytosol / ER) and their consumers; biomass_C drawn with the new Dol-P term only
GREYED: lipid-particle Srt1 chain R217-R235 (census UM6), blocked before and after, not changed

Reaction colour and label = pFBA flux (mmol/gDW/h) on Task A medium + PO1f (uracil open, R612 closed), Gurobi 1e-9; grey = 0; no colour = not in this model or (biomass_C before) without the drawn term. Scenario 'census': open-condition gap census.

Node colour (open census): blue = gap metabolite under ce9e1112, not under 9d655c2b; orange = gap under both; pink = gap only under 9d655c2b; grey = not a gap. Repeated nodes are the same pool. Layout is automatic and carries no biological meaning.
BEFORE: ce9e1112 (ce9e1112ee940531...), pFBA on Task A + PO1f. Grey = no flux; R_DOLSYN not in this model; biomass_C (light grey) lacks the Dol-P term
